issues.desc: background.md uses the term "red/spike" repeatedly (Trigger Event, Key Insights, Solution Tradeoffs, Conversational Texture) without defining it. A newly onboarded reader cannot infer from the text alone what "spike" means (exploratory investigation to refute an approach) or why it is paired with "red" (write a failing test first). The Trigger Event sentence "A red/spike on 2026-06-26 produced a RED test" conflates two concepts without distinguishing them.

background.md uses "repro-first" as a central concept (appears ~8 times, e.g. "repro-first preflight gate", "classifyReproFirstRequirement", "repro-first-required") without defining the term. A new reader cannot tell from the background alone that "repro-first" means "reproduce-the-failure before fixing" (i.e. write a red test pinning the bug before starting implementation). The concept is only partially inferable from context.
